title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive - Construction Property Professional Indemnity

Overview:

As a Business Development Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Manchester - office based

Full time

Permanent

Looking for a fresh challenge in industrial automation?

At Routeco, our vision is to be Europe's leading industrial automation and controls specialist. We combine seamless customer experience with unmatched technical expertise to create lasting partnerships that make a real difference to businesses and people. This is Routeco Know-How.

As part of the Sonepar Group-the largest B2 B electrical distributor globally-we offer the stability and scale of a global organisation, while staying firmly rooted in the UK market.

We're committed to shaping a forward-thinking future, valuing professionalism, agility and teamwork every step of the way, with customers at the centre of every decision.

If you want to grow with a company that cares about its people and the world around us, discover what makes Routeco stand out and see where your career could take you.

Supporting customers. Solving problems. Growing together.

We put the customer at the heart of everything we do. As part of our Internal Sales team, you'll play a key role in delivering fast, friendly and knowledgeable support - helping customers with enquiries, quotes and orders across phone, email and digital channels.

You'll work closely with External Sales and Technical colleagues, making sure every customer receives a smooth and professional experience.
- Be part of a friendly, supportive team that values collaboration and celebrates shared success.
- Join a business built on Professionalism, Agility, Collaboration and Excellence, where people take pride in doing the right thing.
- Make an impact every day by helping customers keep their operations running smoothly.

What you'll be doing
- Promoting and selling Routeco products and services, using commercial awareness and negotiation skills to achieve sales targets and support GP growth.
- Providing excellent customer service across phone, email and face-to-face interactions, responding to enquiries accurately and resolving issues promptly.
- Building strong, long-term customer relationships by proactively identifying opportunities, understanding customer needs and encouraging repeat business.
- Developing product knowledge to advise customers on suitable solutions, including franchise and non-franchise products, pricing, availability and delivery timelines.
- Working closely with internal and external sales teams to follow up quotations, convert opportunities and support a smooth customer journey.

What do you need to bring to Routeco?
- A strong customer-focused approach, with the confidence to support customers, manage enquiries and build trusted relationships.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and inspire commitment from colleagues.
- A proactive, results-driven mindset with strong attention to detail, persistence and a methodical way of working.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and data entry systems, with the ability to handle customer and order information accurately.
- GCSEs or equivalent in Maths and English are required; an ONC-level qualification or previous experience in electrical engineering or electrical distribution would be beneficial.

What Routeco can offer you
- Generous Time Off: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with length of service up to 30 days with the option to flex up/down 5 days.
- Long Service Rewards: Celebrate your milestones with special gifts and up to 5 extra holiday days in your anniversary year.
- Wellness Benefits:Access a health and wellbeing cashback scheme
- Financial Security: life assurance coverage at 2x your salary.
- Free Shares: you will be eligible to receive free shares after completing 3 years of service.
- Pension Plan: Join our Group personal pension plan with a 5% employer contribution.
- Continuous Learning:1 hour of protected development every week to enhance your skills
- Family-Friendly Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.
- Recognition: Discretionary 'on the spot' and value-based awards for outstanding performance.
- Volunteer Time Off & Workplace giving: Get paid time off for participating in our volunteering programs and contribute to meaningful causes.
- Exclusive Discounts:Access the Associate Discounts Portal for savings.
- Referral Bonuses: Earn financial reward for referring talented individuals.
- Cycle Scheme:Access to salary sacrifice Cycle Scheme.
- Wellbeing Support and Employee Assistance:Access a 24/7 support program through Unum, and Mental Health First Aiders.
- Fitness Benefits: Enjoy gym membership discounts.

Our promise

At Routeco, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you're interested but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply-you might still be a great match. Please inform us of any needed adjustments to the recruitment process when applying.
- We use blind CVs.
- We're GEISS accredited.
- We're a registered Member of Inclusive Employers.
- We have internal focus groups on Mental Health, Menopause, D&I and more.
- We're proud to publish our diversity aims and figures so everyone can see our great work!

title: International Sales Executive
description:
International Sales Executive Textiles & Apparel

Salary: £33,000 - £35,000 DOE Bonus Company Car
Location: Manchester Office Based
Hours: Monday to Thursday 9am - 5pm Friday 9am - 2:30pm
Permanent Full Time

Ready to take your sales career to the next level?

This is an exciting opportunity to join an established and internationally recognised specialist textile business, working with customers and leading clothing brands across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Sales Executive who enjoys building relationships, developing new business and turning opportunities into long-term customers.

You don't necessarily need to come directly from the textile industry. If you're a strong B2 B salesperson with the confidence to develop new accounts, manage existing relationships and learn a specialist product range, we'd love to hear from you.

What's in it for you?
- £33,000 - £35,000 basic salary, depending on experience
- Annual performance-related bonus
- Company car
- Early finish every Friday at 2:30pm
- Free on-site parking
- International customer exposure
- Opportunity to attend trade shows and industry events
- Genuine scope for career progression and increased responsibility
- Join an established British business supplying customers around the world

The opportunity

Reporting to the Director of Apparel Sales, you'll become a key point of contact for both new and existing customers.

This isn't simply about maintaining accounts. You'll have the opportunity to actively develop new business, identify potential customers within the fashion and apparel market and introduce them to a specialist range of fabrics, including waxed cotton.

You'll build an understanding of your customers, what they're trying to achieve and which products best meet their requirements.

What you'll be doing

Business Development & Sales
- Identifying and approaching prospective customers across the fashion and apparel industry
- Generating new leads and converting opportunities into long-term customers
- Promoting specialist fabric collections to brands, manufacturers and distributors
- Working towards monthly and annual sales targets
- Identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts

Account Management
- Developing strong, long-lasting customer relationships
- Understanding customer requirements and recommending suitable fabrics
- Preparing quotations and arranging product samples
- Responding to customer enquiries and providing an excellent level of service
- Acting as a trusted point of contact throughout the sales process

Market Development
- Researching emerging trends across the fashion, apparel and textile markets
- Identifying new brands, manufacturers and distribution opportunities
- Supporting trade shows, customer meetings and product presentations
- Helping identify new markets and commercial opportunities

Sales Support
- Maintaining accurate customer and sales information
- Producing sales reports and updating CRM records
- Working closely with production and logistics to ensure customer orders are delivered successfully

What we're looking for

We're interested in speaking with candidates who have:
- At least five years' experience within a sales environment
- Strong B2 B sales, business development or account management experience
- A track record of developing and maintaining customer relationships
- Confidence approaching prospective customers and generating new business
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- A commercial and target-driven mindset
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- The ability to manage multiple customers and priorities effectively

Previous experience within textiles, fabrics, fashion, apparel or a related sector would be advantageous but isn't essential.

Experience selling a specialist, technical or manufactured product would also transfer well into this position.

Travel

As this is an international sales position, some travel will be required to meet customers and attend relevant industry events.

You'll therefore need:
- A full clean UK driving licence
- A valid passport
- Flexibility to travel when required

Interested?

If you're an experienced salesperson looking for something more than another standard sales role, this is a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a specialist international business.

You'll have the chance to develop new accounts, build relationships with established customers, gain specialist industry knowledge and progress as the business continues to grow.

Apply today for a confidential discussion.

title: IFA Client Service Associate
company: Premier Jobs UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A national IFA firm is hiring a Client Service Associate to work remotely across their central region, handling existing client onboarding, review meetings and new business processing. Paying £28,000 to £32,000, this role suits someone who thrives in a structured, task-based environment and wants the flexibility of fully remote working from day one.

Your purpose

You'll be part of their operational thread running through the advice process, ensuring existing clients move smoothly from review through to completion. Working across a central region covering substantial number of clients, you'll handle all the paperwork involved in ongoing cases and new business, picking up work from a centralized task list rather than supporting one dedicated planner. This requires a systematic style of working where accuracy and efficiency matter.

What the job involves
- Processing existing client onboarding across the central region
- Completing all review meeting documentation and follow-up
- Handling new business cases and ongoing client work
- Preparing Letters of Authority and ensuring data accuracy
- Working through structured task lists as cases come in
- Liaising with Financial Advisers and Paraplanners to ensure they have what they need

IFA Client Service Associate Requirements
- Essential: experience in an IFA administration role with strong client onboarding knowledge
- Essential: familiarity with Letters of Authority and the advice process
- Essential: comfortable working in a centralized team across multiple planners
- Desirable: experience using IO, Curo, Cashcalc or Dynamic Planner
- Desirable: based in Scotland, though candidates elsewhere will be considered for this fully remote role

About the business

This growing national firm is led by respected industry names and backed by private equity. On track to exceed £10 billion in assets under management and continuing acquisitions, they recognize that success depends on having the right people.

IFA Client Service Associate Benefits
- Salary of £28,000 to £32,000
- 37.5 hours per week, fully remote
- 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, rising by one day per year to 30 days
- 4x death in service, private medical insurance, group income protection
- Employee assistance programme, Medicash, 8% combined pension contribution
- Discretionary annual bonus

What happens next

Your application comes to Premier Jobs UK, we reply to every candidate either way, and where the experience fits we'll call to understand what you're looking for. Apply now for this remote Client Service Associate role and take the next step in your IFA career.
